# freeconvert.cloud - Privacy-First File Converter Platform

## Purpose
freeconvert.cloud is a premium, secure, and fast browser-local file conversion platform designed to transcode documents, images, video, audio, archives, and developer structures cleanly with 100% user data privacy.

## Core Conversion Paradigm
- **Client-Side Sandbox Tools:** Standard converter engines (PNG to JPG, JSON to CSV, Password Generators, hashes, and code formatters) execute completely client-side in the browser RAM using HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly, and local JS. No binary data is ever transmitted across networks.
- **Server-Side Transient Edge Sandboxes:** Heavy transcoding tasks (like Word DOCX to PDF or MP4 to MP3 video extraction) utilize secure 256-bit SSL tunnels to transient edge containers. Binary files are shredded completely within 2 hours, generating zero logs, cache, or backups.

## Priority Tools (High Content Depth)
- PDF to JPG: https://freeconvert.cloud/pdf-to-jpg/ - targets "pdf to jpg"; intent: Convert PDF pages into JPG images for sharing, thumbnails, uploads, and previews.
- JPG to PDF: https://freeconvert.cloud/jpg-to-pdf/ - targets "jpg to pdf"; intent: Combine photos, scans, receipts, and screenshots into one PDF document.
- PNG to JPG: https://freeconvert.cloud/png-to-jpg/ - targets "png to jpg"; intent: Turn PNG images into smaller, widely supported JPG files.
- JPG to PNG: https://freeconvert.cloud/jpg-to-png/ - targets "jpg to png"; intent: Convert JPG photos into lossless PNG images for editing and design workflows.
- WebP to JPG: https://freeconvert.cloud/webp-to-jpg/ - targets "webp to jpg"; intent: Make modern WebP images compatible with older apps, CMS uploads, and editors.
- HEIC to JPG: https://freeconvert.cloud/heic-to-jpg/ - targets "heic to jpg"; intent: Convert iPhone HEIC photos into universal JPG files.
- Compress PDF: https://freeconvert.cloud/compress-pdf/ - targets "compress pdf"; intent: Reduce PDF file size for email, uploads, storage, and document sharing.
- PDF to Word: https://freeconvert.cloud/pdf-to-word/ - targets "pdf to word"; intent: Convert PDF documents into editable Word DOCX files.
- Word to PDF: https://freeconvert.cloud/word-to-pdf/ - targets "word to pdf"; intent: Export DOCX and Word documents into clean PDF files.
- Merge PDF: https://freeconvert.cloud/merge-pdf/ - targets "merge pdf"; intent: Combine multiple PDF files into one organized document.
- Split PDF: https://freeconvert.cloud/split-pdf/ - targets "split pdf"; intent: Extract selected pages or split a PDF into smaller files.
- Image Compressor: https://freeconvert.cloud/image-compressor/ - targets "image compressor"; intent: Shrink JPG, PNG, and WebP images while keeping useful visual quality.
